metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for the pi-conf pi extensions

plugins.name: multi-review-status
plugins.description: Shows a running multi-review live above the prompt in Claude Code, like pi's progress widget, and warns when the code has moved on since the last review

plugins.name: pi-subagent
plugins.description: Runs pi agents (~/.pi/agent/agents/*.md) as native Claude Code subagents: in the tasks list, in the background, with a viewable transcript; pi does the work
